# Fahad's Portfolio

> The personal website of Mohammed Fahad — a B.Tech CSE student at GEC Palakkad, Kerala, India. A developer's sketchbook showcasing projects, blog posts, a scratchpad of shared links, and a build-in-public log.

Important notes:

- All project source code is open source on GitHub unless marked private
- Blog posts are written in markdown with YAML frontmatter
- The site is built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS
- Design inspired by wandixu.com and scalzodesign.be

## Projects

- [StockFlow](https://justfahad.me/project/stockflow): Real-time B2B order management platform for apparel and textile businesses — Next.js + Django
- [Mudra](https://justfahad.me/project/mudra): Next-generation human-computer interaction through biophysical intelligence — Make-A-Ton 8.0 submission
- [NSS App](https://justfahad.me/project/nss-app): Comprehensive web app to simplify NSS operations — Next.js + TypeScript
- [Enigma](https://justfahad.me/project/enigma): One question per day — compete for fastest completion time on a daily leaderboard — React + TypeScript
- [BlastOff](https://justfahad.me/project/blastoff): Casual endless runner game with vector graphics — Godot. [Source](https://github.com/FahadLive/BlastOff)
- [DocuFlow](https://justfahad.me/project/docuflow): Reducing the hassle of applying for documents — Next.js + Node.js
- [FOSS GEC Palakkad](https://justfahad.me/project/foss-site): Official site of FOSS Cell GECSKP — Vue.js. [Source](https://github.com/FOSS-Cell-GECPKD/Website/)
- [FieldWatch](https://justfahad.me/project/fieldwatch): TinyML project for field monitoring — C. [Source](https://github.com/FahadLive/FieldWatch)
- [Light 'Em Up](https://justfahad.me/project/light-em-up): Recreation of Whack-A-Mole using LEDs and push buttons — hardware game. [Source](https://github.com/FahadLive/light-em-up)
- [Off Topic](https://justfahad.me/project/off-topic): Community intro website for GEC Palakkad's tech community — React + TypeScript

## Blog

- [Life is Good](https://justfahad.me/blog/life-is-good): Finding my people through community — TinkerHub, NSS, and Hack Club
- [How Would I Start Researching](https://justfahad.me/blog/how-would-i-start-researching): A beginner's guide to starting research as a B.Tech student
- [Meeting My GitHub Feed In-Person](https://justfahad.me/blog/meeting-my-github-feed-in-person): Experience at IndiaFOSS 2025 — first event outside Kerala
- [Projects I Made as a Programmer](https://justfahad.me/blog/projects-I-made-as-a-programmer): Overview of the project-building journey
- [Thoughts Behind BlastOff](https://justfahad.me/blog/thoughts-behind-blastoff): Why and how the BlastOff game was built
- [At Least I Tried](https://justfahad.me/blog/atleast-i-tried): Expectation vs reality — college life and finding direction
- [Why READMEs are Important](https://justfahad.me/blog/why-readmes-are-important): The case for better documentation in projects
- [Dethroning Google](https://justfahad.me/blog/dethroning-google): Exploring alternatives to Google services
